paper_title: Pulsar Polarization Array Limits on Ultralight Axion-like Dark Matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma (ALDM Chern-Simons coupling) in GeV^-1, plotted as log10(g_agammagamma/GeV^-1)
notes: First pulsar polarization array (PPA) analysis using 22 MSPs from PPTA DR3 (18-yr span). New observed 95% upper limits on the ALDM Chern-Simons (axion-photon) coupling, assuming local ALDM density rho_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. The paper states best global limits of ~10^-13.5 to 10^-12.2 GeV^-1 over the fuzzy-DM mass range 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV; these two anchor values are the explicit numbers extracted (full exclusion curve in Fig. 2 spans ~10^-23 to 10^-19 eV, with limits scaling ~linearly with m_a above 1/Tobs and as m_a^-2 below, but numerical curve values are not tabulated in the text). Since this is a DM-search (halo birefringence) limit, dm_density_assumed is set. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 51)) | Vision: Traced the red solid 'Full-corr' curve in FIG. 2, which is the paper's headline 95% CL upper limit on the ALDM Chern-Simons coupling g_agamma from the Pulsar Polarization Array analysis of 22 PPTA DR3 MSPs. Limit assumes rho_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Best limit ~1.3e-14 GeV^-1 near m_a ~ 1e-23 eV (m ~ 1/T_obs, T_obs ~ 18 yr). Boundary scales as m_a^-2 below 1/T_obs and roughly linearly with m_a above; sharp oscillatory peaks appear for m_a > ~10^-19.4 eV (timescale <= 1 day), attributed by the authors to imperfect noise modeling. Reference dashed lines: CAST at ~6.6e-11 GeV^-1, SN1987A at ~5.4e-12 GeV^-1, Chandra H1821+643 at ~6e-13 GeV^-1, consistent with y-axis calibration.
